notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]We are thrilled to announce a major update to the game![/b]
Total rework of scientist outpost.
New questline, enemy, and NPC.
Numerous systems have been revamped.
A lot of bugs have been fixed.
Added various in-game flavor elements.

[u][b]
Patch Notes for the Latest Build:[/b][/u]

[b]Sanity Changes:[/b]

Being in the dark now has a chance to decrease your sanity.
Removed reverse look controls.
Reduced sanity damage from enemies.

[b]Weapon Changes:[/b]

You can now reload weapons using bullet boxes instead of magazines.
New weapons added: Uzi, Sten, MG42, and laser artifact.
Updated item spawn mechanics.

[b]Poolrooms Outpost:[/b]

Henry can duplicate owned cards.
Updated Trader.
Added additional NPCs and player rooms/hideouts.
The game now starts in the poolrooms.

[b]Level Fun:[/b]

Multiple partygoers added..
Advancing the quest with Jenny/Alice now possible by dropping a plushie obtained from partygoers by making a cake.

[b]Asylumrooms:[/b]

Collider and door fixes.
Added card spawn and asylumrooms questline along with new scientist - Jeremy.
Introduced asylum enemies.

[b]Boss Changes:[/b]

Different cards from various biomes required to confront the boss.
Boss enters a second stage once below 50% HP.

[b]Quests Changes:[/b]

New asylumroom questline.
Completion of the kinderrooms questline.

[b]Other Changes:[/b]

Henry can craft another card of the same type if shown a card and you possess 10 cigarettes.
Added achievements.
Implemented a new realistic lighting system with baked realtime global illumination and flashlight support for navigating darkroom zones.
Various UI adjustments.
Fixed camera glitches.
Improved hit effects.
Optimized weapon muzzle flash.
Fixed item spawn issues in multiplayer.
Corrected weapon positions.
Increased single item spawns in zones.
Added posters explaining entities in the game world.
Skills are retained after death.

notes.title: 🚀 Backrooms Cycle Early Access Release 🚀
notes.notes:
Attention, brave explorers! The day has finally arrived. Backrooms Cycle is officially launching into Early Access, and we couldn't be more excited to share this incredible adventure with you!

First and foremost,[b] Brace yourselves[/b] for a truly immersive experience like no other. With our groundbreaking procedural world generation, every journey into the enigmatic Yellowrooms will be a unique and thrilling encounter. Expect the unexpected as you navigate through ever-changing corridors, each filled with its own secrets and challenges.

Prepare for an unparalleled level of immersion as you engage in [b]captivating dialogues[/b] and embark on [b]exciting quests[/b]. Dive deep into a rich narrative that will keep you hooked from start to finish. Explore the depths of the Backrooms, encounter enigmatic characters, and make [b]choices that shape your destiny[/b] in this unforgiving realm.

But that's not all—get ready for heart-pounding combat and epic[b] boss fights[/b] that will test your skills and determination. Arm yourself with an extensive arsenal of items and utilize our tetris inventory system to strategically [b]manage your resources[/b]. Break through walls to uncover hidden paths and unveil the secrets that lie beyond.

And the excitement doesn't stop there. Backrooms Cycle offers a multiplayer experience like no other, with no player limit. Join forces with friends and fellow adventurers as you conquer the darkness together. Cooperation and teamwork will be key to survival in this ever-shifting labyrinth.

However, we want to emphasize that Backrooms Cycle is launching in Early Access for a reason. [b]We need your help[/b], your opinions, and your testing expertise to shape this game into its full potential. We're committed to working closely with the community, listening to your feedback, and implementing new content and features based on your suggestions.

This journey is just beginning, and we invite you to join us on this remarkable expedition. As we venture through Early Access, we encourage you to reach out to us on Discord or engage in lively discussions on the Steam forums. Your input will play a vital role in making Backrooms Cycle the best it can be.

We want to express our deepest gratitude to all those who have supported us thus far. Your enthusiasm and passion have been our driving force, and we can't wait to continue this journey with you by our side.

So, grab your flashlight, steel your nerves, and prepare to immerse yourself in the world of Backrooms Cycle. Together, let's unravel the mysteries of the Backrooms and forge our path through this captivating realm.

Thank you for joining us on this incredible adventure!

The Backrooms Cycle Development Team

notes.title: Backrooms Cycle - Unleashing the Power of Playtesting
notes.notes:
Devlog: Backrooms Cycle - Unleashing the Power of Playtesting

Greetings, fearless adventurers! It's time to shed light on the latest developments of our immersive Backrooms game, Backrooms Cycle. We're thrilled to announce that we're actively working on the game and are getting closer to the moment when you can join us on this extraordinary journey. But before that, we need your help in testing and refining the game through an exclusive playtesting phase!

From June 16th to June 19th, we will be conducting an exciting playtest, and we want you to be a part of it. This is your opportunity to get an early taste of Backrooms Cycle and contribute to its shaping. But don't worry if you can't participate this time around – there will be more opportunities in the future. Just keep an eye on our announcements!

During this playtest, we have specific areas we'd love your assistance with. Our primary focus will be on testing the combat mechanics, ensuring that the battles against the abominations lurking in the Backrooms are thrilling and satisfying. Engage in intense encounters, wield powerful weapons, and unleash your skills to overcome the twisted horrors that stand in your way. We want to hear your thoughts on combat balance, responsiveness, and overall enjoyment.

Additionally, we'll be evaluating the quest system, which will provide you with unique objectives and challenges throughout your journey. Embark on thrilling quests, unravel the secrets of the Backrooms, and witness the impact of your choices on the ever-evolving narrative. Help us fine-tune the quest system by providing feedback on quest design, pacing, and overall engagement.

Furthermore, we're excited to gather your insights on the inventory system. Explore the depths of the Backrooms, scavenge for valuable resources, and manage your inventory effectively to survive in this hostile environment. Test the mechanics, experiment with different loadouts, and let us know your thoughts on the interface, usability, and any suggestions you may have.

The playtest will also focus on evaluating our level generation algorithms, which will ensure that each exploration into the Backrooms feels unique and unpredictable. Traverse a labyrinth of procedurally generated corridors, encounter hidden chambers, and uncover secrets scattered throughout the infinite expanse. Share your experiences and observations regarding level variety, coherence, and any unexpected issues that may arise.

Finally, we'd like to emphasize the importance of finding and squashing as many bugs as possible. Your keen eye and meticulous attention to detail will help us identify and eliminate any lurking issues. Report any glitches, inconsistencies, or other technical anomalies you encounter, as your valuable feedback will help us refine and polish Backrooms Cycle to its full potential.

We kindly request all playtesters to join our Discord community, where you can directly interact with the development team and share your experiences with fellow explorers. Your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are invaluable to us, and we greatly appreciate your support in making Backrooms Cycle the best it can be.

We are incredibly grateful for your unwavering enthusiasm and continuous support throughout this journey. Your involvement as playtesters will play a vital role in shaping the final game, and we can't wait to embark on this adventure with you.

Prepare your flashlights, gather your courage, and get ready to immerse yourself in the Backrooms like never before. The playtesting phase is just around the corner!

Stay tuned for more updates, and remember to mark your calendars for June 16th – June 19th. Together, let's conquer the mysteries of the Backrooms!

The Backrooms Cycle Development Team

So, if you want to delve deeper into the lore and witness the unfolding of a captivating story, be sure to follow our game or join our lively Discord community.

Now, let's talk about some of the exciting features we've been working on. Our team has been hard at work implementing an inventory system that will upgrade your exploration experience. Collect artifacts, scavenge for supplies, and piece together the mysteries of the Backrooms, all while keeping your inventory perfectly organized in a tetris-like fashion ;).

In addition to the inventory system, we're thrilled to announce the inclusion of a little base, serving as a sanctuary amidst the unsettling void of the Backrooms. Your base will be a refuge where you can regroup, strategize, and upgrade your equipment. As you progress through the game, you'll have the opportunity to enhance your base, fortifying it against the unknown dangers that lurk just beyond its walls. Create a safe haven tailored to your playstyle and ensure your survival in this surreal and unpredictable realm.

We understand that creating a game is a collaborative journey, and your feedback and suggestions have played an instrumental role in shaping Backrooms Cycle. We want to extend our deepest gratitude to all of our amazing followers who have supported us along the way. Your enthusiasm and passion have been an endless source of inspiration for our team.

As we continue to develop Backrooms Cycle, we invite you to join us on this thrilling adventure. Follow our progress closely, join the discussions on our Discord server, and be part of the vibrant community that is forming around our game. Together, let's unlock the secrets of the infinite corridors and emerge victorious from the Backrooms.

Stay tuned for more updates, as we have many more surprises in store for you. Until then, keep your flashlight ready, your wits sharp, and remember to never stray too far from the familiar.

See you in the Backrooms, explorers!

The Backrooms Cycle Development Team
